subject: Feedback on the calendar mix-up
text: Hi there, I hope your week is going well. I wanted to ask for feedback, because I realized I misread a calendar entry yesterday. I thought our check-in was at 2:30, but it looked like it had already shifted to 4:00. Totally my mistake, and I felt bad for leaving you waiting. Could you let me know if my recollection sounds right? Also, if there is anything you would like me to change before the next session, I am really all ears. No rush to reply.
